The '''Bronze Nimbus''' was one of several [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] units in the [[Jabiimi Military]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Alto Stratus]] served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the unit. When he became disillusioned with the cowardice of the [[Jabiimi Military|Jabiim Army]], he used the Bronze Nimbus as the core for what would become the [[Nationalist Army]]. Eventually, Bronze Nimbus was transformed into the [[Nimbus commando]]s.<ref name="GaW" />
